title: Obscene publication and exhibition relating to children
title_en: Obscene publication and exhibition relating to children
title_si: ළමයින්ට අදාළ අසභ්‍ය ප්‍රකාශන සහ ප්‍රදර්ශනය
legal_text_summary: Prohibits producing, publishing, distributing, displaying, or possessing obscene photographs, videos, or visual representations involving children.
simple_explanation: Prohibits producing, publishing, distributing, displaying, or possessing obscene photographs, videos, or visual representations involving children.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits producing, publishing, distributing, displaying, or possessing obscene photographs, videos, or visual representations involving children.
simple_explanation_si: ළමුන් යොදාගනිමින් අසභ්‍ය ඡායාරූප හෝ වීඩියෝ සෑදීම, ප්‍රකාශයට පත්කිරීම, බෙදා හැරීම හෝ ළඟ තබා ගැනීම තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Save screenshots, block perpetrator, and report to Sri Lanka CERT and NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_en: Save screenshots, block perpetrator, and report to Sri Lanka CERT and NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_si: අසභ්‍ය ද්‍රව්‍ය හා ගිණුම්වල ස්ක්‍රීන්ෂොට් සුරක්ෂිත කරගෙන අදාළ පුද්ගලයා අවහිර කරන්න. ශ්‍රී ලංකා CERT සහ NCPA 1929 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Duty of computer service provider to prevent child sexual abuse
title_en: Duty of computer service provider to prevent child sexual abuse
title_si: ළමා ලිංගික අපයෝජනය වැළැක්වීමට පරිගණක සේවා සපයන්නන්ගේ වගකීම
legal_text_summary: Mandates computer and internet service providers to block, remove, and report child sexual abuse material hosted or transmitted on their services.
simple_explanation: Mandates computer and internet service providers to block, remove, and report child sexual abuse material hosted or transmitted on their services.
simple_explanation_en: Mandates computer and internet service providers to block, remove, and report child sexual abuse material hosted or transmitted on their services.
simple_explanation_si: අන්තර්ජාල හා පරිගණක සේවා සපයන්නන් විසින් තම සේවාවන් ඔස්සේ ළමා අසභ්‍ය ද්‍රව්‍ය සංසරණය වීම වැළැක්වීම සහ වාර්තා කිරීම අනිවාර්ය වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report hosting providers or online platforms distributing CSAM to NCPA and CERT.
reporting_guidance_en: Report hosting providers or online platforms distributing CSAM to NCPA and CERT.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමා අසභ්‍ය ද්‍රව්‍ය පවත්වාගෙන යන වෙබ් අඩවි හෝ සේවා සපයන්නන් පිළිබඳව NCPA සහ CERT වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Duty to inform of use of premises for child abuse
title_en: Duty to inform of use of premises for child abuse
title_si: ළමා අපයෝජනය සඳහා පරිශ්‍ර භාවිතා කිරීම පිළිබඳව තොරතුරු දීමේ වගකීම
legal_text_summary: Imposes a legal duty on owners or occupiers of premises to inform the police if their property is being used for child abuse or sexual exploitation.
simple_explanation: Imposes a legal duty on owners or occupiers of premises to inform the police if their property is being used for child abuse or sexual exploitation.
simple_explanation_en: Imposes a legal duty on owners or occupiers of premises to inform the police if their property is being used for child abuse or sexual exploitation.
simple_explanation_si: යම් පරිශ්‍රයක් ළමා අපයෝජනය සඳහා භාවිතා කරන්නේ නම් ඒ පිළිබඳව පොලිසිය දැනුවත් කිරීම ගොඩනැගිලි හෝ ස්ථාන හිමියන්ගේ වගකීම වේ.
reporting_guidance: Inform police child desk or NCPA immediately if premises are being used for child abuse.
reporting_guidance_en: Inform police child desk or NCPA immediately if premises are being used for child abuse.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමා අපයෝජනය සඳහා යම් ස්ථානයක් භාවිතා කරන්නේ නම් වහාම පොලිසියේ ළමා අංශයට හෝ NCPA වෙත තොරතුරු ලබා දෙන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Causing or procuring children to beg
title_en: Causing or procuring children to beg
legal_text_summary: Makes it an offence to employ, cause, or procure any child to beg or solicit alms.
simple_explanation: Makes it an offence to employ, cause, or procure any child to beg or solicit alms.
simple_explanation_en: Makes it an offence to employ, cause, or procure any child to beg or solicit alms.
simple_explanation_si: ළමුන් සිඟමන් යැවීමට හෝ හිඟාකෑමේ යෙදවීමට අනුබල දීම හෝ යෙදවීම දඬුවම් ලැබිය හැකි අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report child begging syndicates or forced begging to NCPA 1929 or Police 119.
reporting_guidance_en: Report child begging syndicates or forced begging to NCPA 1929 or Police 119.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් සිඟමන් යැවීමේ ජාවාරම් පිළිබඳව වහාම NCPA 1929 හෝ පොලිස් 119 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Hiring or employing children to act as procurers
title_en: Hiring or employing children to act as procurers
title_si: ප්‍රසම්පාදකයන් ලෙස ක්‍රියා කිරීමට ළමයින් රැකියාවෙහි යෙදවීම
legal_text_summary: Prohibits hiring or employing a child to act as a procurer or agent for prostitution or illicit sexual activity.
simple_explanation: Prohibits hiring or employing a child to act as a procurer or agent for prostitution or illicit sexual activity.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits hiring or employing a child to act as a procurer or agent for prostitution or illicit sexual activity.
simple_explanation_si: ලිංගික තැරැව්කාරකම් හෝ ප්‍රසම්පාදන කටයුතු සඳහා ළමයින් රැකියාවල යෙදවීම සපුරා තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report child prostitution rings or procurers immediately to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_en: Report child prostitution rings or procurers immediately to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් ලිංගික තැරැව්කාරකම්වල යොදවන ස්ථාන පිළිබඳව වහාම පොලිස් ළමා හා කාන්තා කාර්යාංශයට වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Hiring or employing children to traffic in restricted articles
title_en: Hiring or employing children to traffic in restricted articles
title_si: තහනම් ද්‍රව්‍ය ජාවාරම් කිරීම සඳහා ළමයින් යෙදවීම
legal_text_summary: Prohibits using, hiring, or employing a child to transport, deal in, or traffic dangerous drugs, narcotics, or restricted illegal articles.
simple_explanation: Prohibits using, hiring, or employing a child to transport, deal in, or traffic dangerous drugs, narcotics, or restricted illegal articles.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits using, hiring, or employing a child to transport, deal in, or traffic dangerous drugs, narcotics, or restricted illegal articles.
simple_explanation_si: තහනම් මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය හෝ නීති විරෝධී භාණ්ඩ ජාවාරම සඳහා ළමයින් යොදා ගැනීම බරපතළ අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report exploitation of children for drug trafficking to Police Narcotic Bureau or Police Emergency 119.
reporting_guidance_en: Report exploitation of children for drug trafficking to Police Narcotic Bureau or Police Emergency 119.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය ජාවාරම් සඳහා යොදා ගැනීම පිළිබඳව පොලිස් මත්ද්‍රව්‍ය නාශක කාර්යාංශයට හෝ 119 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Exposure and abandonment of a child under twelve years
title_en: Exposure and abandonment of a child under twelve years
title_si: අවුරුදු දොළහට අඩු ළමයෙකු අත්හැර දමීම හෝ තනි කිරීම
legal_text_summary: Criminalises exposing or wholly abandoning any child under the age of twelve years by a parent or person having care of such child.
simple_explanation: Criminalises exposing or wholly abandoning any child under the age of twelve years by a parent or person having care of such child.
simple_explanation_en: Criminalises exposing or wholly abandoning any child under the age of twelve years by a parent or person having care of such child.
simple_explanation_si: වයස අවුරුදු 12ට අඩු දරුවෙකුගේ මව්පියන් හෝ භාරකරු විසින් දරුවා අත්හැර දැමීම හෝ අනාරක්ෂිතව තනි කිරීම අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Contact the Police or NCPA 1929 immediately to rescue and secure the safety of an abandoned child.
reporting_guidance_en: Contact the Police or NCPA 1929 immediately to rescue and secure the safety of an abandoned child.
reporting_guidance_si: අත්හැර දැමූ දරුවා බේරා ගැනීමට සහ ආරක්ෂාව තහවුරු කිරීමට වහාම පොලිසිය හෝ NCPA 1929 අමතන්න.

title: Cruelty to children
legal_text_summary: Covers willful assault, ill-treatment, neglect, abandonment, or exposure of a child under 18 by a person having charge of the child, causing unnecessary suffering or health injury.
simple_explanation: Covers willful assault, ill-treatment, neglect, abandonment, or exposure of a child under 18 by a person having charge of the child, causing unnecessary suffering or health injury.
simple_explanation_en: Covers willful assault, ill-treatment, neglect, abandonment, or exposure of a child under 18 by a person having charge of the child, causing unnecessary suffering or health injury.
simple_explanation_si: වයස අවුරුදු 18ට අඩු දරුවෙකුට පහරදීම, කෲර ලෙස සැලකීම, නොසලකා හැරීම හෝ මානසික/ශාරීරික වධදීම බරපතළ වරදකි.
reporting_guidance: Report the cruelty to Police or NCPA 1929 and secure medical care for injuries sustained.
reporting_guidance_en: Report the cruelty to Police or NCPA 1929 and secure medical care for injuries sustained.
reporting_guidance_si: කෲරත්වය පිළිබඳව වාර්තා කර දරුවාට සිදුවී ඇති තුවාල සඳහා වහාම වෛද්‍ය ප්‍රතිකාර ලබා දෙන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Voluntarily causing hurt
legal_text_summary: Defines bodily pain, disease, or infirmity caused voluntarily to any person as hurt.
simple_explanation: Defines bodily pain, disease, or infirmity caused voluntarily to any person as hurt.
simple_explanation_en: Defines bodily pain, disease, or infirmity caused voluntarily to any person as hurt.
simple_explanation_si: පුද්ගලයෙකුට ශාරීරික වේදනාවක්, රෝගයක් හෝ ආබාධයක් කැමැත්තෙන්ම සිදුකිරීම ශාරීරික හානි කිරීමකි.
reporting_guidance: Report physical assault to police child desk or hospital.
reporting_guidance_en: Report physical assault to police child desk or hospital.
reporting_guidance_si: ශාරීරික පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියේ ළමා අංශයට හෝ රෝහලට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Grievous hurt defined
legal_text_summary: Defines severe bodily injuries including fractures, dislocations, permanent loss of sight/hearing, disfiguration, or injuries endangering life.
simple_explanation: Defines severe bodily injuries including fractures, dislocations, permanent loss of sight/hearing, disfiguration, or injuries endangering life.
simple_explanation_en: Defines severe bodily injuries including fractures, dislocations, permanent loss of sight/hearing, disfiguration, or injuries endangering life.
simple_explanation_si: අස්ථි බිඳීම්, අවයව අක්‍රිය වීම්, හෝ ජීවිතයට තර්ජනයක් වන බරපතළ ශාරීරික හානි මෙයින් අර්ථ දක්වයි.
reporting_guidance: Seek immediate hospital medical care and JMO report.
reporting_guidance_en: Seek immediate hospital medical care and JMO report.
reporting_guidance_si: වහාම රෝහල් ගත කර අධිකරණ වෛද්‍ය (JMO) වාර්තාවක් ලබා ගන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt (act)
legal_text_summary: Whoever does any act with the intention of causing hurt or with the knowledge that he is likely to cause hurt commits voluntarily causing hurt.
simple_explanation: Whoever does any act with the intention of causing hurt or with the knowledge that he is likely to cause hurt commits voluntarily causing hurt.
simple_explanation_en: Whoever does any act with the intention of causing hurt or with the knowledge that he is likely to cause hurt commits voluntarily causing hurt.
simple_explanation_si: හානියක් කිරීමේ චේතනාවෙන් හෝ එවැනි හානියක් සිදුවිය හැකි බව දැන දැනම සිදුකරන හිංසනයන් සඳහා දඬුවම් නියම කෙරේ.
reporting_guidance: Report physical assault to police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report physical assault to police.
reporting_guidance_si: ශාරීරික පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
legal_text_summary: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt to any person commits an offence carrying severe custodial punishment.
simple_explanation: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt to any person commits an offence carrying severe custodial punishment.
simple_explanation_en: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt to any person commits an offence carrying severe custodial punishment.
simple_explanation_si: තවත් අයෙකුට හිතාමතාම බරපතළ ශාරීරික හානි සිදුකිරීම සපරාධී වරදකි.
reporting_guidance: Report severe bodily hurt to police child desk and hospital.
reporting_guidance_en: Report severe bodily hurt to police child desk and hospital.
reporting_guidance_si: බරපතළ ශාරීරික හානි පිළිබඳව පොලිස් ළමා අංශයට සහ රෝහලට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
legal_text_summary: Provides penal punishment for voluntarily causing simple bodily hurt.
simple_explanation: Provides penal punishment for voluntarily causing simple bodily hurt.
simple_explanation_en: Provides penal punishment for voluntarily causing simple bodily hurt.
simple_explanation_si: සාමාන්‍ය ශාරීරික පහරදීම් හෝ හානි සිදුකිරීම සඳහා වන දඬුවම් නීතිගත කරයි.
reporting_guidance: Report simple hurt assault to police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report simple hurt assault to police.
reporting_guidance_si: ශාරීරික පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
title_en: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
title_si: භයානක ආයුධ හෝ මගින් හානි සිදුකිරීම
legal_text_summary: Prescribes enhanced penalties for causing bodily hurt using dangerous instruments, weapons, fire, poison, or corrosive substances.
simple_explanation: Prescribes enhanced penalties for causing bodily hurt using dangerous instruments, weapons, fire, poison, or corrosive substances.
simple_explanation_en: Prescribes enhanced penalties for causing bodily hurt using dangerous instruments, weapons, fire, poison, or corrosive substances.
simple_explanation_si: භයානක ආයුධ, ගිනි, වස හෝ විෂ ද්‍රව්‍ය යොදාගනිමින් පහරදීම හෝ ශාරීරික හානි සිදුකිරීමට වැඩි දඬුවම් නියම වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report weapon or corrosive weapon assault immediately to Police 119 and Hospital.
reporting_guidance_en: Report weapon or corrosive weapon assault immediately to Police 119 and Hospital.
reporting_guidance_si: ආයුධ හෝ ගිනි/විෂ යොදා සිදුකරන පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව වහාම පොලිස් 119 සහ රෝහලට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
title_en: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
title_si: භයානක ආයුධ මගින් බරපතල හානි සිදුකිරීම
legal_text_summary: Prescribes severe imprisonment for causing grievous bodily hurt using lethal weapons or dangerous means.
simple_explanation: Prescribes severe imprisonment for causing grievous bodily hurt using lethal weapons or dangerous means.
simple_explanation_en: Prescribes severe imprisonment for causing grievous bodily hurt using lethal weapons or dangerous means.
simple_explanation_si: භයානක ආයුධ මඟින් බරපතළ තුවාල හෝ ශාරීරික හානි සිදුකිරීමට දැඩි සිරදඬුවම් නියම වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report severe weapon assault to Police and request immediate forensic examination.
reporting_guidance_en: Report severe weapon assault to Police and request immediate forensic examination.
reporting_guidance_si: ආයුධ මඟින් සිදුවූ බරපතළ තුවාල පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කර අධිකරණ වෛද්‍ය පරීක්ෂණයකට යොමු වන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing hurt to extort property
title_en: Voluntarily causing hurt to extort property
legal_text_summary: Punishes causing bodily hurt to extort property or force a person to do an illegal act.
simple_explanation: Punishes causing bodily hurt to extort property or force a person to do an illegal act.
simple_explanation_en: Punishes causing bodily hurt to extort property or force a person to do an illegal act.
simple_explanation_si: බලහත්කාරයෙන් දේපළ පැහැර ගැනීමට හෝ නීති විරෝධී ක්‍රියාවලට යෙදවීමට පහරදීම අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report extortion assault to police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report extortion assault to police.
reporting_guidance_si: බලහත්කාරයෙන් පැහැර ගැනීම් හා පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt to extort property
title_en: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt to extort property
legal_text_summary: Punishes causing severe bodily harm to extort property or constrain an illegal act.
simple_explanation: Punishes causing severe bodily harm to extort property or constrain an illegal act.
simple_explanation_en: Punishes causing severe bodily harm to extort property or constrain an illegal act.
simple_explanation_si: දේපළ ලබාගැනීමට හෝ බියගැන්වීමට බරපතළ තුවාල සිදුකිරීම බරපතළ අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report severe extortion hurt to police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report severe extortion hurt to police.
reporting_guidance_si: බලහත්කාරයෙන් පැහැර ගැනීම් හා බරපතළ පහරදීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Sexual harassment
legal_text_summary: Prohibits sexually harassing a person by assault, criminal force, words, or gestures causing sexual annoyance or distress.
simple_explanation: Prohibits sexually harassing a person by assault, criminal force, words, or gestures causing sexual annoyance or distress.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits sexually harassing a person by assault, criminal force, words, or gestures causing sexual annoyance or distress.
simple_explanation_si: පහරදීමකින්, සාපරාධී බලහත්කාරයකින්, වචනයකින් හෝ ක්‍රියාවකින් ලිංගික හිරිහැර කිරීම දඬුවම් ලැබිය හැකි වරදකි.
reporting_guidance: Document offensive messages, comments, or details of physical advances and report to Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_en: Document offensive messages, comments, or details of physical advances and report to Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_si: ලිංගික අදහස්, පණිවිඩ හෝ කායික හැසිරීම් පිළිබඳ තොරතුරු සටහන් කරගෙන පොලිස් ළමා හා කාන්තා කාර්යාංශය වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Kidnapping defined
legal_text_summary: Defines kidnapping as kidnapping from Sri Lanka or kidnapping from lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation: Defines kidnapping as kidnapping from Sri Lanka or kidnapping from lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation_en: Defines kidnapping as kidnapping from Sri Lanka or kidnapping from lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවෙන් පැහැරගැනීම හෝ නීත්‍යානුකූල භාරකාරත්වයෙන් පැහැරගැනීම මෙයින් අර්ථ දක්වයි.
reporting_guidance: Report child kidnapping immediately to Police 119.
reporting_guidance_en: Report child kidnapping immediately to Police 119.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමා පැහැරගැනීම් පිළිබඳව වහාම පොලිස් 119 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping from Sri Lanka
legal_text_summary: Conveying any person beyond the limits of Sri Lanka without consent or consent of authorized person.
simple_explanation: Conveying any person beyond the limits of Sri Lanka without consent or consent of authorized person.
simple_explanation_en: Conveying any person beyond the limits of Sri Lanka without consent or consent of authorized person.
simple_explanation_si: කැමැත්තකින් තොරව පුද්ගලයෙකු ශ්‍රී ලංකා සීමාවෙන් ඔබ්බට රැගෙන යාම පැහැරගැනීමකි.
reporting_guidance: Alert police and border authorities immediately.
reporting_guidance_en: Alert police and border authorities immediately.
reporting_guidance_si: වහාම පොලිසිය සහ ආගමන විගමන බලධාරීන් දැනුවත් කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping from lawful guardianship
legal_text_summary: Taking or enticing any minor (under 14 for males, under 16 for females) or person of unsound mind out of lawful guardianship without consent.
simple_explanation: Taking or enticing any minor (under 14 for males, under 16 for females) or person of unsound mind out of lawful guardianship without consent.
simple_explanation_en: Taking or enticing any minor (under 14 for males, under 16 for females) or person of unsound mind out of lawful guardianship without consent.
simple_explanation_si: භාරකරුගේ කැමැත්තෙන් තොරව බාලවයස්කාර දරුවෙකු (පිරිමි 14ට අඩු, ගැහැණු 16ට අඩු) භාරකාරත්වයෙන් ඉවතට රැගෙන යාම හෝ පොළඹවා ගැනීම.
reporting_guidance: Alert the police immediately. Give full details of suspect, child, and last location seen.
reporting_guidance_en: Alert the police immediately. Give full details of suspect, child, and last location seen.
reporting_guidance_si: වහාම පොලිසිය දැනුවත් කරන්න. සැකකරු, දරුවා සහ අවසන් වරට දුටු ස්ථානය පිළිබඳ සම්පූර්ණ විස්තර ලබා දෙන්න.

title: Abduction defined
legal_text_summary: Defines abduction as compelling by force or inducing by deceitful means any person to go from any place.
simple_explanation: Defines abduction as compelling by force or inducing by deceitful means any person to go from any place.
simple_explanation_en: Defines abduction as compelling by force or inducing by deceitful means any person to go from any place.
simple_explanation_si: බලහත්කාරයෙන් හෝ රවටා යම් ස්ථානයකින් පුද්ගලයෙකු රැගෙන යාම අබුද්ධිය/පැහැරගැනීමක් ලෙස අර්ථ දක්වයි.
reporting_guidance: Report forced abduction to Police 119.
reporting_guidance_en: Report forced abduction to Police 119.
reporting_guidance_si: බලහත්කාරයෙන් පැහැරගැනීම් පිළිබඳව වහාම පොලිස් 119 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Punishment for kidnapping
legal_text_summary: Provides severe penal imprisonment for committing kidnapping from Sri Lanka or lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation: Provides severe penal imprisonment for committing kidnapping from Sri Lanka or lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation_en: Provides severe penal imprisonment for committing kidnapping from Sri Lanka or lawful guardianship.
simple_explanation_si: නීත්‍යානුකූල භාරකාරත්වයෙන් පැහැරගැනීම් සඳහා සිරදඬුවම් නියම කරයි.
reporting_guidance: Report kidnapping to police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report kidnapping to police.
reporting_guidance_si: පැහැරගැනීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder
title_en: Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder
legal_text_summary: Kidnapping or abducting any person with intent to murder or put them in danger of murder.
simple_explanation: Kidnapping or abducting any person with intent to murder or put them in danger of murder.
simple_explanation_en: Kidnapping or abducting any person with intent to murder or put them in danger of murder.
simple_explanation_si: මරා දැමීමේ අරමුණින් පුද්ගලයෙකු පැහැර ගැනීම බරපතළ අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Alert Police emergency 119 immediately.
reporting_guidance_en: Alert Police emergency 119 immediately.
reporting_guidance_si: වහාම පොලිස් හදිසි ඇමතුම් 119 දැනුවත් කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent to confine
title_en: Kidnapping or abducting with intent to confine
legal_text_summary: Kidnapping or abducting a person to secretly and wrongfully confine them.
simple_explanation: Kidnapping or abducting a person to secretly and wrongfully confine them.
simple_explanation_en: Kidnapping or abducting a person to secretly and wrongfully confine them.
simple_explanation_si: පුද්ගලයෙකු සඟවා රහසිගතව සිරකර තැබීමට පැහැරගැනීම අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report wrongful secret confinement to Police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report wrongful secret confinement to Police.
reporting_guidance_si: රහසිගතව සිරකර තැබීම් පිළිබඳව පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping or abducting a woman to compel marriage
title_en: Kidnapping or abducting a woman to compel marriage
title_si: බලහත්කාර විවාහයට හෝ ලිංගික හැසිරීම්වලට කාන්තාවන් පැහැරගැනීම
legal_text_summary: Kidnapping or abducting a woman to force marriage or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation: Kidnapping or abducting a woman to force marriage or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation_en: Kidnapping or abducting a woman to force marriage or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation_si: කාන්තාවකගේ කැමැත්තෙන් තොරව බලහත්කාරයෙන් විවාහ කර ගැනීමට හෝ ලිංගිකව අපයෝජනය කිරීමට පැහැරගැනීම.
reporting_guidance: Report forced marriage kidnapping to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_en: Report forced marriage kidnapping to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_si: බලහත්කාර විවාහ සඳහා පැහැරගැනීම් පොලිස් ළමා හා කාන්තා කාර්යාංශයට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Kidnapping or abducting to subject to grievous hurt or slavery
title_en: Kidnapping or abducting to subject to grievous hurt or slavery
title_si: වහල්භාවයට හෝ බරපතල හානිවලට ලක්කිරීමට පැහැරගැනීම
legal_text_summary: Kidnapping or abducting a person to subject them to grievous hurt, slavery, or unnatural lust.
simple_explanation: Kidnapping or abducting a person to subject them to grievous hurt, slavery, or unnatural lust.
simple_explanation_en: Kidnapping or abducting a person to subject them to grievous hurt, slavery, or unnatural lust.
simple_explanation_si: වහල්භාවයට, බරපතළ වධහිංසාවලට හෝ අස්වාභාවික ලිංගික සූරාකෑමට පුද්ගලයෙකු පැහැර ගැනීම.
reporting_guidance: Report abduction for slavery or severe harm immediately to Police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report abduction for slavery or severe harm immediately to Police.
reporting_guidance_si: වහල්භාවයට හෝ බරපතළ හානිවලට පැහැරගැනීම් වහාම පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Debt bondage, serfdom, forced labour, and recruitment of children for armed conflict
title_en: Debt bondage, serfdom, forced labour, and recruitment of children for armed conflict
title_si: ණය ගැති භාවය, බලහත්කාර ශ්‍රමය සහ සන්නද්ධ ගැටුම් සඳහා ළමයින් බඳවා ගැනීම
legal_text_summary: Criminalises subjecting children to debt bondage, serfdom, forced labor, or recruiting children into armed forces/conflict.
simple_explanation: Criminalises subjecting children to debt bondage, serfdom, forced labor, or recruiting children into armed forces/conflict.
simple_explanation_en: Criminalises subjecting children to debt bondage, serfdom, forced labor, or recruiting children into armed forces/conflict.
simple_explanation_si: ළමයින් ණයගැති භාවයට, බලහත්කාර ශ්‍රමයට හෝ සන්නද්ධ ගැටුම් සඳහා බඳවා ගැනීම සපුරා තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report forced child labour or recruitment to NCPA 1929 or Police Counter-Trafficking Unit.
reporting_guidance_en: Report forced child labour or recruitment to NCPA 1929 or Police Counter-Trafficking Unit.
reporting_guidance_si: බලහත්කාර ළමා ශ්‍රමය හෝ ජාවාරම් පිළිබඳව NCPA 1929 හෝ පොලිස් මිනිස් ජාවාරම් මර්දන අංශයට වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 16 of 2006)

title: Procuration
legal_text_summary: Prohibits procuring, enticing, or detaining a person under 21 years of age for prostitution or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation: Prohibits procuring, enticing, or detaining a person under 21 years of age for prostitution or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits procuring, enticing, or detaining a person under 21 years of age for prostitution or illicit sexual intercourse.
simple_explanation_si: ලිංගික අපයෝජනය හෝ ගණිකා වෘත්තිය සඳහා පුද්ගලයෙකු බඳවා ගැනීම, පොළඹවා ගැනීම හෝ සිරකර තැබීම.
reporting_guidance: Inform the police immediately to carry out a rescue operation and protect the victim.
reporting_guidance_en: Inform the police immediately to carry out a rescue operation and protect the victim.
reporting_guidance_si: දරුවා බේරා ගැනීමට සහ වින්දිතයා ආරක්ෂා කිරීමට වහාම පොලිසිය දැනුවත් කරන්න.

title: Sexual exploitation of children
legal_text_summary: Prohibits commercial sexual exploitation of children, including using children for prostitution, pornography, or commercial sexual acts.
simple_explanation: Prohibits commercial sexual exploitation of children, including using children for prostitution, pornography, or commercial sexual acts.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits commercial sexual exploitation of children, including using children for prostitution, pornography, or commercial sexual acts.
simple_explanation_si: වාණිජ ලිංගික කටයුතු, ගණිකා වෘත්තිය හෝ අසභ්‍ය දර්ශන සඳහා ළමුන් ලිංගිකව සූරාකෑම බරපතළ අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report child sexual exploitation rings or material to NCPA 1929 and Police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report child sexual exploitation rings or material to NCPA 1929 and Police.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් ලිංගිකව සූරාකෑමේ ජාවාරම් පිළිබඳව NCPA 1929 සහ පොලිසිය වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Trafficking
legal_text_summary: Criminalises buying, selling, recruiting, transporting, harboring, or receiving a child for exploitation, forced labor, or sexual trade.
simple_explanation: Criminalises buying, selling, recruiting, transporting, harboring, or receiving a child for exploitation, forced labor, or sexual trade.
simple_explanation_en: Criminalises buying, selling, recruiting, transporting, harboring, or receiving a child for exploitation, forced labor, or sexual trade.
simple_explanation_si: සූරාකෑමේ, බලහත්කාර ශ්‍රමයේ හෝ ලිංගික වෙළඳාමේ අරමුණින් ළමුන් මිලදී ගැනීම, විකිණීම, ප්‍රවාහනය හෝ ජාවාරම් කිරීම.
reporting_guidance: Contact the Police Counter-Trafficking Unit or Police Emergency 119 immediately without confronting suspects.
reporting_guidance_en: Contact the Police Counter-Trafficking Unit or Police Emergency 119 immediately without confronting suspects.
reporting_guidance_si: සැකකරුවන් සමඟ මුහුණට මුහුණ ගැටීමට නොගොස් වහාම පොලිස් මිනිස් ජාවාරම් මර්දන අංශය හෝ 119 අමතන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995 / Act No. 16 of 2006)

title: Offences related to adoption
title_si: දරුකමට ගැනීම සම්බන්ධ අක්‍රමිකතා හා අපරාධ
legal_text_summary: Prohibits illegal adoption transactions, buying or selling children under the pretext of adoption, or illegal child placement.
simple_explanation: Prohibits illegal adoption transactions, buying or selling children under the pretext of adoption, or illegal child placement.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits illegal adoption transactions, buying or selling children under the pretext of adoption, or illegal child placement.
simple_explanation_si: දරුකමට ගැනීමේ මුවාවෙන් සිදුවන නීති විරෝධී මුදල් ලබාගැනීම්, ළමුන් විකිණීම් හෝ අක්‍රමිකතා තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report illegal child adoption sales to Probation Department and Police.
reporting_guidance_en: Report illegal child adoption sales to Probation Department and Police.
reporting_guidance_si: නීති විරෝධී දරුකමට ගැනීමේ ජාවාරම් පිළිබඳව පරිවාස දෙපාර්තමේන්තුවට සහ පොලිසියට වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Soliciting a child
title_si: ළමයෙකු ලිංගික අපයෝජනය සඳහා පොළඹවා ගැනීම
legal_text_summary: Prohibits grooming, soliciting, or enticing a child under 18 years for sexual abuse or illicit sexual acts.
simple_explanation: Prohibits grooming, soliciting, or enticing a child under 18 years for sexual abuse or illicit sexual acts.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits grooming, soliciting, or enticing a child under 18 years for sexual abuse or illicit sexual acts.
simple_explanation_si: ලිංගික අපයෝජනය හෝ අසභ්‍ය ක්‍රියා සඳහා ළමයෙකු පොළඹවා ගැනීම, පෙළඹවීම හෝ ග්‍රූමින් කිරීම.
reporting_guidance: Report child grooming or soliciting to NCPA 1929 and Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_en: Report child grooming or soliciting to NCPA 1929 and Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් පෙළඹවීම් හෝ ග්‍රූමින් කිරීම් පිළිබඳව NCPA 1929 සහ පොලිස් ළමා හා කාන්තා කාර්යාංශයට වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Rape (Statutory Rape)
legal_text_summary: Defines rape. Crucially under Clause 5, sexual intercourse with a female under 16 years of age constitutes statutory rape with or without her consent. Clauses 1-4 cover non-consensual sexual intercourse regardless of age.
simple_explanation: Defines rape. Crucially under Clause 5, sexual intercourse with a female under 16 years of age constitutes statutory rape with or without her consent. Clauses 1-4 cover non-consensual sexual intercourse regardless of age.
simple_explanation_en: Defines rape. Crucially under Clause 5, sexual intercourse with a female under 16 years of age constitutes statutory rape with or without her consent. Clauses 1-4 cover non-consensual sexual intercourse regardless of age.
simple_explanation_si: ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණය අර්ථ දක්වයි. 5 වන වගන්තිය යටතේ වයස 16ට අඩු ගැහැණු ළමයෙකු සමඟ කැමැත්ත ඇතිව හෝ නැතිව සිදුකරන ලිංගික සංසර්ගය ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණයකි.
reporting_guidance: Take the child immediately to a government hospital for medico-legal examination. Do not clean or wash the child to preserve evidence.
reporting_guidance_en: Take the child immediately to a government hospital for medico-legal examination. Do not clean or wash the child to preserve evidence.
reporting_guidance_si: වෛද්‍ය පරීක්ෂණයක් සඳහා වහාම දරුවා රජයේ රෝහලකට රැගෙන යන්න. සාක්ෂි විනාශ වීම වැළැක්වීමට දරුවා සේදීම හෝ පිරිසිදු කිරීම නොකරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Punishment for rape
legal_text_summary: Prescribes mandatory minimum imprisonment and penalties for committing rape or statutory rape.
simple_explanation: Prescribes mandatory minimum imprisonment and penalties for committing rape or statutory rape.
simple_explanation_en: Prescribes mandatory minimum imprisonment and penalties for committing rape or statutory rape.
simple_explanation_si: ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණය හෝ ළමා ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණය සඳහා වන අනිවාර්ය බරපතළ සිරදඬුවම් නීතිගත කරයි.
reporting_guidance: Report rape immediately to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_en: Report rape immediately to Police Women & Children Bureau.
reporting_guidance_si: ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණය පිළිබඳව වහාම පොලිස් ළමා හා කාන්තා කාර්යාංශයට වාර්තා කරන්න.

title: Incest
legal_text_summary: Criminalises sexual intercourse or sexual acts between close blood relations or adoptive family members.
simple_explanation: Criminalises sexual intercourse or sexual acts between close blood relations or adoptive family members.
simple_explanation_en: Criminalises sexual intercourse or sexual acts between close blood relations or adoptive family members.
simple_explanation_si: සමීප ලේ ඥාතීන් හෝ දරුකමට ගත් පවුල් සබඳතා ඇති අය අතර සිදුවන ලිංගික අපචාර සපුරා තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Ensure child is kept in safe shelter away from domestic relative and report to authorities immediately.
reporting_guidance_en: Ensure child is kept in safe shelter away from domestic relative and report to authorities immediately.
reporting_guidance_si: දරුවා අදාළ ඥාතියාගෙන් වෙන් කර ආරක්ෂිත ස්ථානයක රඳවන්න, වහාම බලධාරීන්ට වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Unnatural offences
legal_text_summary: Prohibits carnal intercourse against the order of nature with any man, woman, or animal.
simple_explanation: Prohibits carnal intercourse against the order of nature with any man, woman, or animal.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits carnal intercourse against the order of nature with any man, woman, or animal.
simple_explanation_si: ස්වභාවධර්මයට පටහැනිව සිදුවන අස්වාභාවික ලිංගික හැසිරීම් හෝ අතවර දඬුවම් ලැබිය හැකි වරදකි.
reporting_guidance: Consult the child desk at police and seek medico-legal evaluation.
reporting_guidance_en: Consult the child desk at police and seek medico-legal evaluation.
reporting_guidance_si: පොලිසියේ ළමා අංශය සම්බන්ධ කරගෙන වෛද්‍ය පරීක්ෂණයක් සඳහා යොමු වන්න.

title: Acts of gross indecency
legal_text_summary: Prohibits committing, procuring, or attempting to procure gross indecent acts between persons.
simple_explanation: Prohibits committing, procuring, or attempting to procure gross indecent acts between persons.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits committing, procuring, or attempting to procure gross indecent acts between persons.
simple_explanation_si: පුද්ගලයන් අතර සිදුවන බරපතළ අශෝභන හෝ අශීලාචාර ක්‍රියාවන් සිදුකිරීම හෝ අනුබල දීම අපරාධයකි.
reporting_guidance: Report incident and secure psychological counselling for the child.
reporting_guidance_en: Report incident and secure psychological counselling for the child.
reporting_guidance_si: සිද්ධිය වාර්තා කර දරුවාට මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක උපදේශන සහාය ලබා දෙන්න.

title: Grave sexual abuse
legal_text_summary: Prohibits grave sexual abuse, including non-penile insertion of objects or body parts into the body of another, or severe non-consensual sexual violation for sexual gratification.
simple_explanation: Prohibits grave sexual abuse, including non-penile insertion of objects or body parts into the body of another, or severe non-consensual sexual violation for sexual gratification.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits grave sexual abuse, including non-penile insertion of objects or body parts into the body of another, or severe non-consensual sexual violation for sexual gratification.
simple_explanation_si: ලිංගික තෘප්තිය සඳහා ශරීරයට කිසියම් අවයවයක් හෝ උපකරණයක් ඇතුළු කිරීම හෝ ස්ත්‍රී දූෂණය නොවන බරපතළ ලිංගික අපයෝජනයන්.
reporting_guidance: Seek immediate medico-legal support and do not wash clothes or child to preserve evidence.
reporting_guidance_en: Seek immediate medico-legal support and do not wash clothes or child to preserve evidence.
reporting_guidance_si: වහාම අධිකරණ වෛද්‍ය සහාය ලබා ගන්න. සාක්ෂි සුරැකීමට දරුවාගේ ඇඳුම් හෝ දරුවා සේදීමෙන් වළකින්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

title: Publication of matter relating to certain offences
title_en: Publication of matter relating to certain offences
title_si: ළමා වින්දිතයන්ගේ නම හෝ ඡායාරූප ප්‍රසිද්ධ කිරීම තහනම් කිරීම
legal_text_summary: Prohibits publishing the name, address, photo, or identity of child victims or witnesses of sexual or physical abuse in media or online.
simple_explanation: Prohibits publishing the name, address, photo, or identity of child victims or witnesses of sexual or physical abuse in media or online.
simple_explanation_en: Prohibits publishing the name, address, photo, or identity of child victims or witnesses of sexual or physical abuse in media or online.
simple_explanation_si: අපයෝජනයට ලක්වූ ළමා වින්දිතයන්ගේ නම, ඡායාරූප හෝ අනන්‍යතාවය මාධ්‍ය මඟින් හෝ අන්තර්ජාලයෙන් ප්‍රසිද්ධ කිරීම තහනම් වේ.
reporting_guidance: Report media or social media exposure of child victim identities to NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_en: Report media or social media exposure of child victim identities to NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමා වින්දිතයන්ගේ අනන්‍යතාවය මාධ්‍ය මඟින් ප්‍රසිද්ධ කිරීම් පිළිබඳව NCPA 1929 වෙත වාර්තා කරන්න.
source: Sri Lanka Penal Code (Amendment Act No. 22 of 1995)

law_name: National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998
title: Definition of Child Abuse
legal_text_summary: Defines child abuse under Sri Lankan law as including physical abuse, sexual abuse, cruelty, neglect, trafficking, and illegal adoption of children.
simple_explanation: Defines child abuse under Sri Lankan law as including physical abuse, sexual abuse, cruelty, neglect, trafficking, and illegal adoption of children.
simple_explanation_en: Defines child abuse under Sri Lankan law as including physical abuse, sexual abuse, cruelty, neglect, trafficking, and illegal adoption of children.
simple_explanation_si: ශ්‍රී ලංකා නීතිය යටතේ ළමා අපයෝජනයට ශාරීරික, ලිංගික, කෲරත්වය, නොසලකා හැරීම සහ ජාවාරම් කිරීම් ඇතුළත් බව අර්ථ දක්වයි.
reporting_guidance: NCPA is the primary authority coordinating prevention of child abuse and protecting victims.
reporting_guidance_en: NCPA is the primary authority coordinating prevention of child abuse and protecting victims.
reporting_guidance_si: ජාතික ළමා ආරක්ෂක අධිකාරිය (NCPA) යනු ළමා අපයෝජන වැළැක්වීම සහ වින්දිතයන් ආරක්ෂා කිරීමේ ප්‍රධාන බලධාරියා වේ.
source: National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998

law_name: National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998
title: Power to Enter and Inspect Premises
title_en: Power to Enter and Inspect Premises
legal_text_summary: Empowers authorized NCPA officers and police to enter, search, and inspect premises where child abuse or illegal detention of a child is suspected.
simple_explanation: Empowers authorized NCPA officers and police to enter, search, and inspect premises where child abuse or illegal detention of a child is suspected.
simple_explanation_en: Empowers authorized NCPA officers and police to enter, search, and inspect premises where child abuse or illegal detention of a child is suspected.
simple_explanation_si: ළමා අපයෝජනයක් සිදු වන බවට සැක සහිත ස්ථාන සහ පරිශ්‍ර පරීක්ෂා කිරීමට බලයලත් නිලධාරීන්ට බලය ලබා දේ.
reporting_guidance: Report premises where children are illegally detained or abused to NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_en: Report premises where children are illegally detained or abused to NCPA 1929.
reporting_guidance_si: ළමුන් රඳවාගෙන අපයෝජනය කරන ස්ථාන පිළිබඳව NCPA 1929 වෙත තොරතුරු ලබා දෙන්න.
source: National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998
